messages:
eng-oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — SLO alert: customer=SaffronCorp p99 generation latency > 6s (streaming stalls observed). Auto-escalation to #incidents.

mara: saw the bot — p99 jumped ~2x at 12:04 UTC, p95 ~1.4x. Impacting their dedicated pool (ded-37). Streaming sessions are stalling mid-response.

eli: quick context: SaffronCorp ran a rollout of a new ingest script this morning that parallelizes 12 requests/sec per session and attaches multi-line prompts (including embedded JSON + base64 data). We've been seeing very high KV cache churn and some workers hitting long GC pauses.

sasha: samples from logs (sanitized):
```
[12:04:22] session=abc123 prompt_len=18k tokens kv_hits=0 kv_evictions=312 worker=serv-12 latency=9.1s stream_state=stalled
[12:04:24] session=def456 prompt_len=2.3k tokens kv_hits=4 kv_evictions=45 worker=serv-09 latency=6.7s stream_state=ok
```

rachel: customer reports multiple users seeing partial responses and then reconnect attempts. They've raised a support ticket saying this started after their ingest change.

mara: immediate mitigation proposal: 1) throttle SaffronCorp's max_concurrency for the route to 4 2) route traffic to fallback model variant quantized-x2 with lower memory pressure 3) schedule rolling restart for serv-12 group after draining.

eli: +1. Also suggest disabling per-request batch_affinity for that route (their client sets parallel=12). That will reduce artificial fanout.

mara: executing mitigation step 1 now — lowering concurrency:
```bash
# set route throttle for customer route
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/routes/saffroncorp/controls -d '{"max_concurrency":4}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED"
```

ops-bot: control applied: max_concurrency=4 for route saffroncorp (effective in ~10s).

eng-oncall-bot: fallback plan: switch routing to model rdl-7b-quant-fast for new requests, keep existing in-flight on rdl-13b for correctness. Applying canary to 10% of new sessions.

sasha: starting canary. Command:
```bash
# canary route to quantized variant
redwood route update saffroncorp --model rdl-7b-quant-fast --percent 10 --note "mitigate KV pressure"
```

rachel: letting customer-support know and asking SaffronCorp to roll back parallelization if they can. Customer-support: any response from their eng?

customer-support: SaffronCorp says they can temporarily set parallel=2 on their SDK within 5–10 minutes. They've flagged this as high priority and asked for updates every 5 mins.

eli: observed immediate drop in KV evictions on canary instances (serv-21): evictions->12/min vs 300/min previously. Early latency numbers: p99 on canary ~3.2s, main pool still ~7.8s.

mara: rolling restart queued for serv-12 group, draining connections first. CLI: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/serv-12 --namespace=redwood-serving --grace-period=60`

ops-bot: drain started for serv-12, 60s grace. In-flight sessions will be allowed to finish up to 120s before forced kill.

eli: also enabling aggressive prefix caching for the customer route to try to reuse repeated initial tokens across sessions (they have a lot of identical headers in prompts). Command run.

sasha: quick note — enabling prefix cache will help if prompt prefixes repeat. If their payload is large embedded blobs, we should also limit max_prompt_size per request to avoid extremely long KV entries. Suggest max_prompt_size=12k tokens.

mara: applying max_prompt_size limit now.

eng-oncall-bot: change applied: max_prompt_size=12k for saffroncorp. New oversized requests will be rejected with 413 and a diagnostic hint.

rachel: update to SaffronCorp: we've throttled concurrency, started a canary to lower-memory model, applied prefix caching, and set prompt size limit. Asking them to reduce client parallelism to 2.

customer-support: SaffronCorp confirms they've set parallel=2. Early real-user metrics show fewer reconnections. They asked: will we keep the quantized fallback? They prefer correctness.

mara: keep canary at 10% for now to verify stability. If p99 on main pool drops below 5s in the next 20 minutes, we can roll back fallback. Also plan: follow-up patch to serving runtime to avoid aggressive KV eviction under multi-request sessions (tracking issue created: INF-3821).

eli: timeline: 12:04 alert -> 12:06 throttle applied -> 12:09 canary/limit applied -> 12:12 customer reduced parallelism. Current p99 (12:15): main pool 4.9s, canary 3.1s, p95 main 1.1s. Looking better.

mara: handing off to night oncall (sasha) for monitoring and post-incident writeup. If p99 resurges above 6s, re-open page.

sasha: oncall takeover ack. I'll keep 5-min polling and post updates. Will capture timeline + root cause notes for postmortem.

eng-oncall-bot: incident state -> mitigated. Please add any follow-up tasks to INF-3821 and tag eng-runtime and eng-platform. :white_check_mark:
